[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing shadows on a cracked and dusty road
Watching moonlight dance upon the heavy load
The city fades behind a veil of gray
Chasing ghosts of light that drift away
[Pre-Chorus]
The engine hums a low and steady song
Finding where the restless hearts belong
[Chorus]
Wilder skies are calling out my name
Burning bright like an untamed flame
Driving deep into the great unknown
Finding seeds of truth that I have sown

The horizon stretches like a copper wire
Rising from the ashes of the evening fire

Reclaiming all the beauty of my youth
[Chorus]
Wilder skies are calling out my name
Burning bright like an untamed flame
Driving deep into the great unknown

Lost in the space between the stars
Healing the lines and the hidden scars
[Chorus]
Wilder skies are calling out my name
Burning bright like an untamed flame
Driving deep into the great unknown
Finding seeds of truth that I have sown
[Outro]
